telegramApprovals.title: Urgent approvals on Telegram
telegramApprovals.sub: Money decisions from your phone, with your PIN.
telegramApprovals.owner: Only the owner can use this page.

mode.MOCK: The bot is not connected yet (Keys & connections). Nothing is sent to Telegram.

card.title: Settings
card.on: Send urgent approvals to my Telegram
card.help: Tap Approve or Reject, then type your PIN in the chat. The PIN message is deleted at once.
card.refund: Refund of a prepaid order that was cancelled
card.wait2: After that it waits here; nothing happens by itself.
card.connected: The bot now sends its button taps to the ERP.
card.note: Only the owner’s Telegram can approve. 5 wrong PINs in a day raise an alarm; 20 stop Telegram approvals until you unlock them here.

example.title: Example on Telegram
example.text:
Needs your OK
Big COD order · 9,500 Tk

[ Approve ]  [ Reject ]
After Approve the bot asks: “Type your PIN”.

lock.locked: Telegram approvals are locked after too many wrong PINs.
lock.wrong: Wrong PINs asked for in the last day: {n}

errors.OWNER_ONLY: Only the owner can do this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: That request is not there any more.
errors.NOT_CONNECTED: Connect the Telegram bot in Keys & connections first.
errors.TELEGRAM_REFUSED: Telegram did not accept it. Try again.
errors.PIN_NOT_SET: The owner has not set a PIN yet.
errors.PIN_LOCKED: Too many wrong tries. Wait a while.
